summary: RETEST after iteration_11 fixes. Roommate Pairing UI is fully functional with 'hbh_admin_token' key - load/pair/unpair all work end-to-end. Castlerosse Park Resort visible on homepage. Invoice email endpoint improvement is INCOMPLETE: still returns empty 500 error ({"detail":"Failed to send invoice: "}) because send_transactional_email raises an exception (not returns None), so the new partial_success branch is unreachable.
passed: Admin login via UI redirects to /admin and stores JWT under 'hbh_admin_token' in sessionStorage
/admin/roommates loads successfully with no 'Fehler beim Laden' error
Counters show 2 Gesamt / 2 Ungepaard / 0 Gepaard (matches 2 shared bookings test1@example.com, test2@example.com)
GET /api/admin/shared-room-bookings returns the 2 shared bookings via public API

UI pairing: selecting 2 unpaired guest cards + 'Als Zimmerpartner zuordnen' button triggers POST /api/admin/pair-roommates, shows success message 'Zimmerpartner erfolgreich zugeordnet!' and renders them under 'Gepaarte Zimmerpartner' section (counters flip to 0 Ungepaard / 2 Gepaard)
UI unpairing: 'Paarung aufheben' button triggers POST /api/admin/unpair-roommate, shows 'Paarung aufgehoben' and removes the paired section
Homepage renders and contains 'Castlerosse' (Castlerosse Park Resort)

failed.area: Backend - Invoice email error message (iteration_11 fix incomplete)
failed.issue: POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/send-invoice still returns 500 with empty detail: {"detail":"Failed to send invoice: "}. The new 'if email_id ... else partial_success' branch (server.py lines 3773-3781) is never reached because send_transactional_email raises an exception (likely HTTPException with empty/None detail) rather than returning None. The outer 'except Exception as e' wraps it as f'Failed to send invoice: {str(e)}' which yields an empty string.
failed.evidence: curl -X POST .../api/admin/bookings/<id>/send-invoice -> HTTP 500 body: {"detail":"Failed to send invoice: "}. Confirmed same empty-detail output as iteration_11.

action_items: In send_invoice_email handler (server.py ~3783): catch HTTPException separately and surface its detail, and also handle the case where str(e) is empty - e.g.: 'except HTTPException as he: raise HTTPException(500, detail=f"Failed to send invoice: {he.detail or \'upstream email service error\'}")' and ensure send_transactional_email returns None (not raises) when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is missing so the partial_success branch kicks in.
Alternatively, make send_transactional_email catch its own errors and return None with a logged reason so the already-added partial_success response path is used.
